# Local paths for the upstream NOTICE

Upstream `NOTICE.md` refers to `skill/reference/ios.md` and `skill/reference/android.md`.
In this repo those files are:

- `.cursor/skills/impeccable/reference/ios.md`
- `.cursor/skills/impeccable/reference/android.md`

They remain the ehmo `platform-design-skills` distillation, MIT, author ehmo, as stated in `NOTICE.md`.
This product is a Next.js website. Do not apply those native visual systems.

`SKILL.md` is modified: a local wrapper was inserted after the frontmatter, and the description field was narrowed so the skill only catches typography, spacing, and contrast. The upstream description is quoted in that wrapper and is not in force.
